## What changed

## Evidence

- [ ] Added or updated synthetic tests.
- [ ] `ruff check .` and `ruff format --check .` pass.

- [ ] Core coverage remains at least 90%.

- [ ] Executable case assertions and claims-registry evidence were updated when behavior changed.

## Boundaries
